title: Graphs with Minimum Algebraic Connectivity I: Proofs of Aldous-Fill and Guiduli-Mohar Conjectures
summary: Aldous and Fill (2002) conjectured that the maximum relaxation time of a random walk on a connected regular graph with $n$ vertices is bounded above by $(1+o(1))\frac{3n^2}{2π^2}$, with asymptotic equality for even $n$. Since the relaxation time of a $d$-regular graph $G$ is $d/μ(G)$, where $μ(G)$ denotes its algebraic connectivity, this conjecture is closely related to the problem of minimizing algebraic connectivity among regular graphs.
